defmodule ImageProxy.Router do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  @max_dimension 8192
  @max_pixels 67_108_864

  get "/resize/:width/:height/*path" do
    with {:ok, width} <- parse_dimension(width),
         {:ok, height} <- parse_dimension(height),
         :ok <- validate_allocation(width, height),
         {:ok, image_data} <- fetch_upstream(path) do
      case ImageProxy.Pipeline.process(image_data, width, height) do
        {:ok, result} -> send_resp(conn, 200, result)
        {:error, reason} -> send_resp(conn, 422, "Processing failed: #{reason}")
      end
    else
      {:error, :dimension_exceeded} -> send_resp(conn, 400, "Dimension too large")
      {:error, :allocation_exceeded} -> send_resp(conn, 400, "Image too large")
      {:error, :invalid_path} -> send_resp(conn, 400, "Invalid path")
      {:error, :fetch_failed} -> send_resp(conn, 502, "Upstream error")
    end
  end

  defp parse_dimension(val) do
    case Integer.parse(val) do
      {n, ""} when n > 0 and n <= @max_dimension -> {:ok, n}
      _ -> {:error, :dimension_exceeded}
    end
  end

  defp validate_allocation(width, height) do
    if width * height <= @max_pixels, do: :ok, else: {:error, :allocation_exceeded}
  end

  # Only allow safe path segments: reject empty segments, traversal, and
  # characters that could alter the effective host or request target.
  defp sanitize_path(path_parts) do
    valid? =
      is_list(path_parts) and path_parts != [] and
        Enum.all?(path_parts, fn seg ->
          is_binary(seg) and seg != "" and seg != "." and seg != ".." and
            Regex.match?(~r/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/, seg)
        end)

    if valid?, do: {:ok, path_parts}, else: {:error, :invalid_path}
  end

  defp fetch_upstream(path_parts) do
    with {:ok, safe_parts} <- sanitize_path(path_parts) do
      url = "http://internal-storage:9000/" <> Enum.join(safe_parts, "/")

      case HTTPoison.get(url, [], [timeout: 5000, recv_timeout: 10000]) do
        {:ok, %{status_code: 200, body: body}} -> {:ok, body}
        _ -> {:error, :fetch_failed}
      end
    end
  end
end

defmodule ImageProxy.Pipeline do
  @moduledoc """
  Image processing pipeline that handles resize operations.
  Uses NIF bindings to a C library for pixel manipulation.
  """

  @channels 4
  @header_size 8

  def process(image_data, target_width, target_height) do
    with {:ok, {src_width, src_height, pixels}} <- decode_raw(image_data),
         {:ok, buffer} <- allocate_target(target_width, target_height),
         {:ok, resized} <- bilinear_resize(pixels, src_width, src_height, buffer, target_width, target_height) do
      {:ok, encode_raw(resized, target_width, target_height)}
    end
  end

  defp decode_raw(<<w::unsigned-integer-32, h::unsigned-integer-32, pixels::binary>>) do
    expected_size = compute_buffer_size(w, h)
    if byte_size(pixels) == expected_size do
      {:ok, {w, h, pixels}}
    else
      {:error, :corrupt_image}
    end
  end
  defp decode_raw(_), do: {:error, :invalid_format}

  defp compute_buffer_size(width, height) do
    # Native arbitrary-precision arithmetic - no overflow possible in Elixir
    width * height * @channels
  end

  defp allocate_target(width, height) do
    size = compute_buffer_size(width, height)
    {:ok, :binary.copy(<<0>>, size)}
  end

  defp bilinear_resize(src_pixels, src_w, src_h, target_buffer, dst_w, dst_h) do
    # Compute scale factors
    x_ratio = if dst_w > 1, do: (src_w - 1) / (dst_w - 1), else: 0.0
    y_ratio = if dst_h > 1, do: (src_h - 1) / (dst_h - 1), else: 0.0

    result = for y <- 0..(dst_h - 1), x <- 0..(dst_w - 1), into: <<>> do
      src_x = trunc(x_ratio * x)
      src_y = trunc(y_ratio * y)
      offset = (src_y * src_w + src_x) * @channels
      case src_pixels do
        <<_::binary-size(offset), r::8, g::8, b::8, a::8, _::binary>> ->
          <<r, g, b, a>>
        _ ->
          <<0, 0, 0, 0>>
      end
    end

    {:ok, result}
  end

  defp encode_raw(pixels, width, height) do
    <<width::unsigned-integer-32, height::unsigned-integer-32, pixels::binary>>
  end
end

defmodule ImageProxy.ReverseProxy do
  @moduledoc """
  Nginx configuration expects X-Original-URI to contain the full resize path.
  The proxy passes Content-Length from upstream which we use for pre-allocation
  validation before the pipeline runs.
  """

  def validate_content_length(content_length, width, height) do
    # Pre-check: upstream Content-Length header should be consistent
    # with the declared dimensions in the image header
    channels = 4
    header = 8
    expected_min = width * height * channels + header
    content_length >= expected_min
  end
end
